title: GTA 6 free poster: India's boxed copy has no disc
description: GTA 6 free poster and T-shirt offers are showing up in Indian stores, but the boxed copy holds only a download code. Here's what NDTV reports.

body.text: Indian stores are now stocking boxed copies of GTA 6, and some shops are adding a GTA 6 free poster and T-shirt on top, according to NDTV. The catch is that the box contains no game disc, only a code to download the game. It matters because it shows how the most awaited game in years is reaching Indian buyers, and how much the price is dominating the conversation.
What is actually inside the boxed GTA 6 in India
NDTV says the pack looks like a traditional physical edition from the outside. Open it and there is no disc. Instead, buyers get a digital download code, a display case and a poster.

The game can already be downloaded in advance, according to the report, but it stays locked until it officially unlocks on November 19. So the box is closer to a collectible with a code than a disc you can pop into a console.
GTA 6 free poster and T-shirt deals at local shops
NDTV reports that a few local shops are sweetening the offer with extras. These include free GTA 6 T-shirts and additional posters.

The report does not name the shops or say how many are doing this, so treat the freebies as store-by-store offers rather than something every buyer will get. If you plan to pick up a boxed copy, ask what is included before you pay.
GTA 6 price in India: how people are reacting
NDTV rounded up reactions from social media, and pricing came up repeatedly. These are user posts, not verified data.

items: One user argued that people who play GTA 6 in India should pay more, saying 66 dollars is way too cheap.

Another user shared a worldwide comparison of the Standard Edition in equivalent US dollars, using exchange rates from 10 November. According to that post, India's price is almost the lowest, behind only Japan.
A shared graph on days of work needed to afford the game put India at 25.9 days, while Switzerland needed just 5 hours. NDTV does not detail how the graph was calculated.
Another user looked back at the long gap between GTA 5 in 2013 and GTA 6 in 2026, noting that a generation of Indian fans grew from teenagers into adults in between.

body.text: NDTV also links to a separate story about a company hiring a gamer to play GTA 6 for a reported Rs 1 crore a year, though the details are in that article and not this one.

The next date to mark is November 19, when the pre-downloaded game is due to unlock. Watch whether more Indian retailers stock the code-in-a-box format and whether the poster and T-shirt extras spread beyond a few shops. Also keep an eye on the price debate, since the comparisons going around are social media claims and not official figures. We will update if more detail comes in.

sources.title: GTA 6 Launches In India: Here's How People Are Reacting
